_snapshot.source: models.dev first-party pricing extract — the second catalog (rm-1532). Rows are the dated Anthropic model ids the LiteLLM snapshot carries NO first-party row for in any form (verified against live LiteLLM 2026-10-16, research run b1e8b617): only reseller-qualified rows (openrouter/, vercel_ai_gateway/, github_copilot/) end in these ids, so the base-model collapse attributed first-party sessions to a reseller. Rates are the vendor's list prices as published by models.dev, cross-checked against the reseller rows (identical, since resellers forward list pricing). Each row self-retires the day LiteLLM ships a first-party row: serving_catalog consults the LiteLLM ladder first and a first-party winner ends the search.
_snapshot.rates_basis: USD per million tokens (input, output, cache_read, cache_write)
